welcome:
👋 Hi! Welcome to Luna Coffee Roasters.

Pick a question below for an instant answer, or tap "Talk to a person" to message our team.
humanPrompt: Sure! Just type your message here (you can also send photos or files) and someone from our team will answer you in this chat.
messageReceived: ✅ Got it! Your message was sent to our team. You'll get the answer right here.
deliveryFailed: 😕 Sorry, we couldn't deliver your message right now. Please try again in a few minutes.

items.question: 🕘 Opening hours
items.answer: We're open Monday to Friday 8:00–19:00 and Saturdays 9:00–14:00. Closed on Sundays and public holidays.

items.question: 🚚 Shipping & delivery
items.answer: We ship nationwide in 2–4 business days. Orders over $40 ship for free; below that, shipping is a flat $5.

items.question: 💳 Payment methods
items.answer: We accept credit and debit cards, bank transfer and PayPal. Wholesale customers can also pay on 30-day terms.

items.question: ☕ Wholesale for cafés
items.answer: Yes! We supply cafés and offices with fresh-roasted beans every week. Tap "Talk to a person" and tell us roughly how many kilos a month you need.

items.question: 📍 Where are you?
items.answer: Our roastery and shop are at 123 Harbor Street. Free parking is available right behind the building.
